messages:
Lena: heads up — nightly eval shows a sharp quality drop on the 'contract_summarize' prompt set after applying the new INT8 profile to llama3-13B-ext. sample: output truncates important clauses and adds an extra obligation.
Samir: ugh, how big is the drop?
eval-bot: nightly_eval | model=llama3-13B-ext | profile=int8_v4-candidate | prompt_set=contract_summarize | metric=ROUGE-L | baseline=0.712 | current=0.649 | delta=-0.063 (-8.9%)
Alex R: thanks. can you paste one example pair (input vs fp16 vs int8)?
Lena: here — short thread: 
Lena: INPUT: "Summarize the client's obligations under section 4.2 regarding delivery timelines."
Lena: FP16_OUTPUT: "Client must deliver within 30 days; delays require written notice and may incur liquidated damages as per Section 9."
Lena: INT8_OUTPUT: "Client must deliver within 30 days. The provider may impose additional fees." 
Maria: that's a clear omission + hallucinated fee.
Samir: first triage checklist: 1) repro locally with eval harness 2) compare logits / token probs 3) inspect calibration stats and per-layer scales 4) check whether we used per-channel vs per-tensor quantization
Lena: repro run started (eval-harness --model llama3-13B-ext --profile int8_v4-candidate --prompts contract_summarize) — attaching logs in gcs link: gs://redwood-evals/1840123456/logs.txt
nora-bot: upload complete — logs available: gs://redwood-evals/1840123456/logs.txt
Samir: quick look: tail of generation shows low softmax mass on tokens that FP16 picks; INT8 has flattened distribution occasionally -> misrank. can you dump token-level KL per step?
Alex R: also check calibration set composition — any recent change? we moved from wiki/parlai mix to legal-only subset for calibration last week.
Maria: that could bias scale estimates for legal-domain phrasing. INT8 calibration may be overfitting common legal tokens and under-scaling rare connective tokens -> truncation/hallucination.
Lena: running debug dump: `python tools/dump_token_stats.py --model-path /mnt/models/llama3-13B-ext --profile int8_v4-candidate --prompts contract_summarize --out /tmp/184012_dump.json`
Samir: add `--per-layer-hist` and `--compare-baseline /mnt/models/llama3-13B-ext-fp16`
Lena: done, pushing artifact: gs://redwood-evals/1840123456/dumps/per_layer_hist.csv
Alex R: quick grep: layer 26 and 27 scales show many zeros and a few very large outliers in calibration -> suspect outlier clipping failed. did we change clipping threshold?
Lena: the INT8 profile config shows `clip_pct: 0.001` vs `0.01` in previous profile. I can try rerun calibration with 0.01 to see if it stabilizes.
Maria: try also per-channel symmetric vs asymmetric — asymmetric reduced dynamic range in some heads last time.
Samir: another test: run `--no-calib` eval (run straight quantize-by-absmax) to see if issue is calibration-specific or quantization math. If no drop, calibration is the culprit.
Lena: kicked both reruns (no-calib + calib clip_pct=0.01). ETA ~15m.
nora-bot: rerun started (job id: r-184012-2).
(eval silence ~10m)
Lena: results in: no-calib profile -> ROUGE-L 0.704 (much closer to baseline). calib+clip0.01 -> ROUGE-L 0.709.
Maria: that points at calibration config making it worse.
Samir: root cause hypothesis: aggressive clipping removed rare but semantically important high-magnitude activations in a few middle layers, causing token probability skew on legalconnectives. Solution: prefer looser clipping + per-channel calibration + add a legal-domain calibration subset to improve coverage.
Alex R: agree. action items: 1) revert production profile to int8_v3 (previous stable) for scheduled hosts 2) iterate on int8_v4 with clip_pct=0.01 + per-channel + augmented legal calib set 3) add token-level KL threshold alert (fail if per-token KL > 0.2 at any step across prompt set)
Lena: I'll open a PR to update production flag and a follow-up ticket for the calibration sweep.
Lena: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/962 (revert int8_v4 -> int8_v3 on llama3-13B-ext)
Samir: nice. also add a short unit test in nightly harness that compares fp16 vs quantized top-5 token overlap for contract_summarize prompts (fail if overlap < 0.85).
Maria: noted — I'll add the legal calibration shard to the shared bucket.
Lena: thanks all, will update once deploys and new evals land. :thumbsup:
